final: WITH per AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amt FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS o FROM per), kept AS (SELECT event_name, avg_amt FROM per, overall WHERE avg_amt > o), kavg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kept.event_name, kept.avg_amt AS average_amount, kept.avg_amt - overall.o AS diff_from_overall, kept.avg_amt / kavg.k AS ratio_to_kept_avg FROM kept, overall, kavg
